easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the creature token enters, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
